title: Pineapple motif doily
excerpt: A round doily in lace weight yarn with pineapple motifs radiating outward from the centre. The classic pineapple pattern uses clusters of trebles and chain arcs.
sourceNotes: A traditional round pineapple doily with 6 pineapple sections surrounding a small central motif.

glossaryTerms.definition: A classic doily stitch where rows of treble clusters decrease inward to form a tapered shape resembling the scales of a pineapple.
The widest row of a pineapple section, worked with the maximum number of trebles side by side before the decreasing rows begin.

crochet.gaugeText: 6 pineapple sections across approx. 30 cm diameter.

Magic ring. Round 1: ch 3, 17 trebles into ring (18 tr). Join. Round 2: ch 3, *ch 2, skip 2, tr in next tr; repeat from * (6 ch-2 spaces). Round 3: 3 tr in each ch-2 space.

Round 4: *ch 4, skip 1, dc in next tr; repeat to form base arcs for 6 pineapples. Round 5: work 9 tr into each base arc (base fan). Rounds 6 to 10: decrease each pineapple by 1 treble each round (8 tr, 7 tr, 6 tr... down to 3 tr), filling the side gaps with chain arcs. Final round: 1 tr at each pineapple tip, ch 5 between tips, picot at the arc centres.
Fasten off and weave in the end with the tapestry needle. Block by pinning to a board and misting.
